title: CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines
abstract: arXiv:2611.29494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.

translated_title: CoHABIT：通过空间规则与家庭日常活动的互补评估家具布局
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CoHABIT，一个通过互补的空间规则和家庭日常活动来评估家具布局的框架。静态评估捕捉几何有效性、人体工学可达性、功能组织以及可配置的设计偏好（包括风水）。动态评估使用学习到的住户策略来模拟多智能体家庭中的日常活动、资源共享、协调以及个体负担。受控比较表明，空间标准与家庭行为能够揭示布局质量的不同侧面，而住户画像和时间安排会影响家具布置方案的排名。通过对家庭需求的独立验证，动态比较被建立在可观察的结果之上，从而能够对布置好的环境如何服务于不同家庭进行可解释的评估。
tldr: 该论文提出CoHABIT框架，将基于静态空间规则（几何、人体工学、功能组织及风水等偏好）的评估与基于学习策略的多智能体家庭日常活动动态模拟相结合，实现对家具布局质量的互补性、可解释评估。
en_tdlr: CoHABIT is a framework that complements static spatial-rule-based evaluation (geometry, ergonomics, functionality, Feng Shui preferences) with dynamic simulation of learned multi-agent household routines, enabling interpretable, behavior-grounded assessment of furniture layouts.
